Mr. J. L. Johnson Acting Chief, Engineering Division Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Re: U.S. Corps of Engineers, Fort Worth District -- Development of Environmental Impact Statement for International Boundary and Water Commission's Project Involving Addition of Hydroelectric Generators, Amistad Lake.
Dear Mr. Johnson:
This is in response to your letter of April 22, 1976, in which you:
1. Advised us that the International Boundary and Water Commission (IBWC) had requested the Fort Worth District Corps of Engineers to prepare an Environmental Impact Statement for IBWC's proposed construction project involving the addition of two hydroelectric generators to a previously-excavated powerhouse site at the international Amistad Lake project. Further, you indicated that the "(H)ydroelectric power operations will alter the pattern of downstream flows and the fluctuating pattern of Amistad Lake itself."
2. Informed us that your Office is "...presently gathering information on various parameters as required by the National Environmental Policy Act, Public Law 91-190." And, that in order to avoid conflict during the planning process you requested that we inform you of any land use plans which the Texas Water Rights Commission might have in the affected project area or any environmental impact about which the Commission might have concerns.
The following staff comments are furnished for your consideration, with the special proviso that they not be misconstrued as an "advance expression
